title: ROOF PANEL LOCKS
summary: Coupe (19437) removable roof panel (T-top) latching: the front and rear roof panel locks (paddle latches) screwed to the roof panel, the guide header (locating pin) and front roof center lock at the front edge over the windshield header, and the front roof locating wedge plates at the rear roof. Locks are adjusted for a 13-16 lb release load at the paddle edge; the wedge plates are screwed on and sealed/glued at the weatherstrip area.
